'''2001 Normal DPC Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team event held at Cyberia (Gamer's Haven), Normal, Illinois on 25 February 2001. Team Old Man Secret Squirrel (team: [[Geoff Snider]], [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Chris Hunter]]) won it. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1808">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-geoffs-dpc-team-eventd1808/ geoffs-dpc-team-event], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-geoffs-dpc-team-eventd1808/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Normal DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 25 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Cyberia (Gamer's Haven), Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' Team Old Man Secret Squirrel (team: [[Geoff Snider]], [[Scott Lingrell]], [[Chris Hunter]])
